firmwareList.releaseNotes:
Resolved issue : 
DoS attacks target the cloud-based Portal authentication service in Myanmar.
New main changes :
1. SD-WAN：real-time speed tests on SD-WAN links.
2. ACL：expanded the maximum number of ACL entries (ACEs)  
3. Network：WAN sub-interface configuration .
4. Network: temporary quota in an existing WAN data plan
5. Auth & Accounts: data plan expiration and quota exhaustion notifications, as well as rate-limiting policies
6. Turbo Mode
7. DNS: DNS blocklist and allowlist.
Note: Above 1-6 features not supported by the RG-EG1XX series
